text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, well after the Japanese Derby had 
passed—Cheval Grand spotted Kitasan Black 
shedding tears during training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black admires Tokai Teio. However, 
the one standing closest to her position 
was not herself, but Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, with Duramente suffering a 
bone fracture, it overlaps even more with 
the figure she idolized, plunging Kitasan 
Black into deep despair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand had always felt inferior to 
her sisters. She came to realize that she 
was not the only one who struggled with 
comparing herself to others.
